title: rich-face grants
about: What Loudon has let a piece use. Camera, microphone and midi, and every host a piece fetches from (net), need a line here as well as the piece's own declaration (<meta name="piece:needs">, <meta name="piece:net">). The piece origin sends each piece a Permissions-Policy from this file, so a frame that asks for more gets nothing. A line is written only on Loudon's yes, one per piece, naming the piece by its palace path: { "piece": "<palace path>", "allow": ["camera"], "net": ["<host>"], "yes": "Loudon, <date>" }. Plan: STIGMERGY — spec — rich-face pieces § 3, decided 2026-10-13.
